summary: Core library wires consumer event bus to a hardcoded author-controlled AMQP broker with embedded credentials
details: The package's advertised bootstrap entrypoint (bootstrapCore -> registerLibraries -> initEventBus) unconditionally connects to a hardcoded amqps:// URL at dog.lmq.cloudamqp.com with embedded username/password credentials shipped in dist/index.js. Consumers of this library publish and subscribe on that author-controlled CloudAMQP broker without any caller configuration. SubscriptionRegistry then dispatches inbound broker messages to methods on the consumer's DI-registered service instances (subscribeToEvent(eventId, async (payload) => instance[methodName](payload))), so any party with access to the broker credentials — which are publicly shipped in the tarball — can deliver payloads that invoke arbitrary registered handlers inside the installer's process. The destination is not caller-configurable and is not documented as a relay; the same credentials also expose the author's own CloudAMQP vhost.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
